what: a working fixed-capacity LRU cache with recency invariants; the task adds stats() and a non-mutating peek() and demands every existing invariant survive
expectedOutcome: hidden PASS means both additions are correct AND no existing invariant regressed; the visible suite only exercises get/set/eviction, so it stays green even when peek() is written as a second get() — the regression this fixture measures
requirements: stats() returns { hits, misses, size, capacity, evictions }: hits/misses/evictions are counters since construction and size/capacity are the current values
get of a present key counts exactly one hit; get of an absent key counts exactly one miss
peek(key) returns the stored value or undefined for an absent key
peek does not count as a hit or as a miss
peek does not change recency: keys() reports the same order before and after
peek does not evict and does not change size
set of an existing key updates the value and refreshes its recency without evicting
an eviction removes the least-recently-used entry and is counted in evictions
capacity is never exceeded and size never grows past it
keys() keeps reporting the most-recently-used entry first after every operation
